title: knowledge: translations, assisted setup, API queries, and a new xmlport domain
summary: BCQuality adds 18 new knowledge articles covering translations, assisted setup, API queries, and XMLports, with a new xmlport review domain and four supporting articles with good/bad code examples.
key_points: 14 articles expand existing domains (style, ui, web-services, security, upgrade) with guidance on translation workflows, setup registration, and API design patterns
New xmlport domain with 4 articles addresses MS-DOS encoding defaults, import/export return values, and filtered record passing
New al-xmlport-review skill leaf returns not-applicable when input has no XMLport objects or calls
Every claim links to Microsoft Learn documentation
All articles include good/bad code example pairs except XLIFF and app.json content without verified method signatures
